method.label: Count the people on each side

annotationRationale: The solution converts ordinal positions into counts and combines three disjoint parts to obtain the total.
sourceMethod: Follows the official partition into the people on the left, the specified person, and the people on the right.

review.mathCheck: The specified person has 1012 people to the left and 1009 to the right. These disjoint groups plus that person total 1012+1+1009=2022, choice B.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA Q1, p.2, using exactly the official left-group, specified-person and right-group decomposition.
review.annotationCheck: Both ordinal endpoints include the specified person, and the candidate correctly accounts for this. The statement and printed key agree; no missing step.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: 几和第几 matches ordinal-to-cardinal conversion, and 部分与总数 matches adding the three disjoint parts.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: K.CC.B.4/4b overlap cardinal meaning, without establishing ordinal conversion or counting-order invariance. K.CC.B.5 and 1.OA.A.1/2.OA.A.1 share the counting and part-whole structure, but their numerical bounds exclude this example. The unknown-addend method of 1.OA.B.4 is not used. These remain partial conceptual crosswalks.
